  • Class
    Description
    Area
    A group of tiles on a map, and the choosing of tiles from it.
    AreaFactory
    Builds the Areas the game uses: the named shapes it already relies on (within a radius, adjacent, centred on a tile, the whole map), plus AreaFactory.of(List) for any custom list of tiles a caller has put together itself.
    BareOfItems
    Met by the tiles that have no Item lying on them.
    BreakableTile
    Met by the tiles whose Ground exposes the Breakable capability.
    EnterableBy
    Met by the tiles that a given Actor is able to enter.
    Explosion
    An explosion that hurts every Actor standing in an Area.
    FreeTiles
    The tiles of one map that are still free while the game world is being set up, and the one rule for using them: something placed at random goes on a random free tile, and that tile is then taken.
    HoldsActor
    Met by the tiles that have an Actor standing on them.
    ItemDropper
    Moves Items onto, and off, the tiles of an Area.
    ItemFactory
    Produces a fresh Item each time it is asked.
    OutsideOf
    Met by the tiles that are not part of a given Area.
    PlantableTile
    Met by the tiles whose ground a plant can be planted on (see Plantable).
    TileCondition
    A condition that a tile may or may not meet, used to narrow an Area down (see Area.filter(TileCondition)).
    TileListDescription
    Describes a list of tiles as a single string, so a message about an effect that touches several tiles at once still names exactly where each one happened.
    WaterableTile
    Met by the tiles whose Ground exposes the Waterable capability.
